answers.question: PART 2 — PASSAGE COMPLETION Questions 13–17 Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the option that best fits each numbered blank from 13 to 17. A SQUARE THAT CAN CHANGE WITH THE DAY Central Square is busy in the morning and evening, but many people avoid its open central area on hot, sunny afternoons. Instead of covering the whole square permanently, planners have proposed several movable shade panels. (13) ______. The panels can be arranged in different ways depending on how the square is being used. To planners, this solution sounds (14) ______ because the same open space can still be used for markets, performances, or ordinary daily activities. Some nearby shop owners were concerned that the panels might hide their signs. Designers therefore raised the structures and kept clear views towards the shop fronts. (15) ______. The panels will normally be moved by small electric motors. However, planners know that automatic equipment can occasionally stop working, so staff will also be able to operate the panels manually. (16) ______. The purpose is not to make the square as technologically complicated as possible. (17) ______. Question 13.A. The new structures would permanently divide the square into several smaller areas.B. The panels would remain closed even when large public events were being held.C. The panels could provide shade when needed and move aside for larger events.D. The project would replace the open square with a fully enclosed building.Write A, B, C or D: [Blank 1] Question 14.A. flexibleB. flexiblyC. flexibilityD. flexWrite A, B, C or D: [Blank 13] Question 15.A. As a result, the shops would no longer be visible from the square.B. The owners therefore asked planners to remove every shade structure.C. The change meant that only temporary shops could operate nearby.D. This adjustment addressed the concern without removing the shade plan.Write A, B, C or D: [Blank 3] Question 16.A. The square would therefore remain closed whenever an electric motor stopped.B. This backup would let staff move the panels if automatic controls failed.C. For this reason, the planners decided that all automatic controls were unnecessary.D. The manual controls would be available only during large evening performances.Write A, B, C or D: [Blank 4] Question 17.A. Instead, the planners want to remove all activities that do not require technology.B. The final design assumes that every visitor will prefer the same use of the square.C. The goal is to use a simple system that lets one public space serve different needs.D. The project therefore gives technology priority over the comfort of people using the square.Write A, B, C or D: [Blank 5]
